blind.description: A metal standing brazier or fire basket. It features a deep bowl-shaped basket constructed from dark wrought iron slats with a crenelated upper rim and horizontal reinforcing bands fastened with rivets. The basket is mounted on a sturdy tripod base of three outward-splayed legs joined by a circular reinforcing ring. The interior of the basket is filled to near the brim with textured grey coals or charcoal chunks. Surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with no active flame or glow.
blind.from_above: A circular iron rim with crenelated teeth surrounding a round bed of rough, irregular grey charcoal chunks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (reaching roughly waist height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide across the rim.
